```{r}
# Load necessary packages

library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstanarm)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(bayesrules)
```

```{r}
# Load World Bank indicators 2015-2020
## Internet users (%), Secondary school enrollment (%), GDP per capita (USD), Life expectancy at birth

raw <- WDI(
indicator = c(
  "IT.NET.USER.ZS", 
  "SE.SEC.ENRR",
  "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD", 
  "SP.DYN.LE00.IN" 
),
start = 2015, end = 2020,
extra = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Clean and summarize data

cleaned <- raw %>%
  # kept rows only w/ all required indicators
  filter(!is.na(IT.NET.USER.ZS),
         !is.na(SE.SEC.ENRR),
         !is.na(NY.GDP.PCAP.CD),
         !is.na(SP.DYN.LE00.IN)) %>%
  # averaged values over 2015–20 per country
  group_by(country, region, income) %>%
  summarize(
    internet = mean(IT.NET.USER.ZS, na.rm = TRUE),
    school_enroll = mean(SE.SEC.ENRR, na.rm = TRUE),
    gdp = mean(NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, na.rm = TRUE),
    lifeexp = mean(SP.DYN.LE00.IN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # removed remaining NAs + transform variables
  filter(!is.na(internet), !is.na(school_enroll), !is.na(lifeexp)) %>%
  mutate(
    log_gdp = log(gdp + 1),                 
    internet_c = internet - mean(internet),
    school_c = school_enroll - mean(school_enroll),
    log_gdp_c = log_gdp - mean(log_gdp)
  )

summary(cleaned)
```

```{r}
# Exploratory Visualizations

## Internet vs Life Expectancy
ggplot(cleaned, aes(x = internet, y = lifeexp)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Life Expectancy vs Internet Access",
       x = "Internet Users (% population)",
       y = "Life Expectancy (years)")

## School Enrollment vs Life Expectancy
ggplot(cleaned, aes(x = school_enroll, y = lifeexp)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Life Expectancy vs. School Enrollment",
       x = "School Enrollment (% gross)",
       y = "Life Expectancy (years)")

## Log GDP vs Life Expectancy
ggplot(cleaned, aes(x = log_gdp, y = lifeexp)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Life Expectancy vs GDP per capita",
       x = "log(GDP per capita, USD)",
       y = "Life Expectancy (years)")
```

```{r}
# Specify Priors

# Intercept prior
x0 <- seq(40, 100, length.out = 200)
y0 <- dnorm(x0, mean = 72, sd = 10)
ggplot(data.frame(x0, y0), aes(x = x0, y = y0)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Intercept (beta_0)", y = "Prior density", title = "Prior for Intercept")

# Sigma prior (same for rest of predictors)
x1 <- seq(-20, 20, length.out = 200)
y1 <- dnorm(x1, mean = 0, sd = 5)
ggplot(data.frame(x1, y1), aes(x = x1, y = y1)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Internet coefficient (beta_1)", y = "Prior density", title = "Prior for Internet")

# Sigma prior
x_sigma <- seq(0, 20, length.out = 200)
y_sigma <- dexp(x_sigma, rate = 0.1)
ggplot(data.frame(x_sigma, y_sigma), aes(x = x_sigma, y = y_sigma)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Sigma (residual SD)", y = "Prior density", title = "Prior for sigma")
```

```{r}
# Fit Bayesian linear regression using rstanarm (from 9.3.1 of Bayes Rule)

set.seed(123)
wdi_model <- stan_glm(
lifeexp ~ internet_c + school_c + log_gdp_c,
data = cleaned,
family = gaussian(),
prior_intercept = normal(72, 10),
prior = normal(0, 5),
prior_aux = exponential(0.1), # for sigma
chains = 4, iter = 2000
)
```

```{r}
# Convergence Diagnostics

neff_ratio(wdi_model)
rhat(wdi_model)

# Trace plots
mcmc_trace(as.array(wdi_model))

# Density overlays
mcmc_dens_overlay(as.array(wdi_model))
```

```{r}
# Posterior Summaries

posterior_summary <- tidy_draws(wdi_model) %>%
  median_qi(.width = 0.95)

posterior_summary

posterior_draws <- wdi_model %>%
  tidy_draws() %>%
  select(`(Intercept)`, internet_c, school_c, log_gdp_c, sigma)

posterior_probs <- posterior_draws %>%
  summarize(
    p_intercept_pos = mean(`(Intercept)` > 0),
    p_internet_pos  = mean(internet_c > 0),
    p_school_pos    = mean(school_c > 0),
    p_gdp_pos       = mean(log_gdp_c > 0),
    p_sigma_pos     = mean(sigma > 0)
  )

posterior_probs
```


```{r}
# Posterior Pairwise Scatter Plots (Collinearity Diagnostics)

# Extract posterior draws for coefficients
posterior <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(wdi_model)[, 
                   c("internet_c", "school_c", "log_gdp_c")])

# Rename for clearer labels
posterior <- posterior %>%
  rename(
    `Internet Access (centered)` = internet_c,
    `Years of Schooling (centered)` = school_c,
    `Log GDP per Capita (centered)` = log_gdp_c
  )

# Internet vs Schooling 
ggplot(posterior, aes(`Internet Access (centered)`,
                      `Years of Schooling (centered)`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Internet Access vs Years of Schooling",
       x = "Internet Access (centered)",
       y = "Years of Schooling (centered)")

# Internet vs Log GDP
ggplot(posterior, aes(`Internet Access (centered)`,
                      `Log GDP per Capita (centered)`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Internet Access vs Log GDP per Capita",
       x = "Internet Access (centered)",
       y = "Log GDP per Capita (centered)")

# Schooling vs Log GDP
ggplot(posterior, aes(`Years of Schooling (centered)`,
                      `Log GDP per Capita (centered)`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Years of Schooling vs Log GDP",
       x = "Years of Schooling (centered)",
       y = "Log GDP per Capita (centered)")
```

```{r}
# PRIOR SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS

set.seed(123)

## Original prior: Normal(0,5)
wdi_model  # already fit earlier

## Narrower prior: Normal(0,2)
wdi_model_prior_narrow <- stan_glm(
  lifeexp ~ internet_c + school_c + log_gdp_c,
  data = cleaned,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior_intercept = normal(72, 10),
  prior = normal(0, 2),
  prior_aux = exponential(0.1),
  chains = 4, iter = 2000, refresh = 0
)

## Wider prior: Normal(0,10)
wdi_model_prior_wide <- stan_glm(
  lifeexp ~ internet_c + school_c + log_gdp_c,
  data = cleaned,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior_intercept = normal(72, 10),
  prior = normal(0, 10),
  prior_aux = exponential(0.1),
  chains = 4, iter = 2000, refresh = 0
)

# Summaries for posterior median & CI 
summarize_post <- function(fit, label) {
  tidy_draws(fit) %>%
    select(`(Intercept)`, internet_c, school_c, log_gdp_c, sigma) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
                 names_to = "param",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(param) %>%
    summarize(
      median = median(value),
      lo95  = quantile(value, 0.025),
      hi95  = quantile(value, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(model = label)
}

post_orig   <- summarize_post(wdi_model, "orig_N0_5")
post_narrow <- summarize_post(wdi_model_prior_narrow, "narrow_N0_2")
post_wide   <- summarize_post(wdi_model_prior_wide, "wide_N0_10")

post_compare <- bind_rows(post_orig, post_narrow, post_wide) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = c(median, lo95, hi95)
  )

# Compute differences using clean column names
post_compare <- post_compare %>%
  mutate(
    diff_med_narrow = median_narrow_N0_2 - median_orig_N0_5,
    diff_med_wide   = median_wide_N0_10 - median_orig_N0_5,
    pct_change_med_narrow = 100 * diff_med_narrow / abs(median_orig_N0_5),
    pct_change_med_wide   = 100 * diff_med_wide   / abs(median_orig_N0_5)
  )

# Table output
knitr::kable(
  post_compare,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Comparison of posterior medians and changes under alternative slope priors"
)

# Overlay posterior densities plot
draws_orig   <- tidy_draws(wdi_model) %>% mutate(model = "orig: N(0,5)")
draws_narrow <- tidy_draws(wdi_model_prior_narrow) %>% mutate(model = "narrow: N(0,2)")
draws_wide   <- tidy_draws(wdi_model_prior_wide) %>% mutate(model = "wide: N(0,10)")

draws_all <- bind_rows(draws_orig, draws_narrow, draws_wide) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`(Intercept)`, internet_c, school_c, log_gdp_c, sigma),
    names_to = "param",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(
  filter(draws_all, param %in% c("internet_c", "school_c", "log_gdp_c")),
  aes(x = value, fill = model)
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~ param, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Densities under Different Slope Priors",
    subtitle = "Comparing original (N(0,5)), narrower (N(0,2)), and wider (N(0,10)) priors",
    x = "Coefficient value",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Prior"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Posterior Predictive Simulations

## Define scenarios
posterior_draws <- tidy_draws(wdi_model)

## Rename parameters to avoid conflicts with scenario variables
posterior_draws <- posterior_draws %>%
  rename(
    b_Intercept  = `(Intercept)`,
    b_internet_c = internet_c,
    b_school_c   = school_c,
    b_log_gdp_c  = log_gdp_c,
    b_sigma      = sigma
  )

## Scenario definitions (low, average, high values)
new_countries <- tibble(
  internet_c = c(-20, 0, 20),
  school_c   = c(-10, 0, 10),
  log_gdp_c  = c(-1, 0, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = paste0(
      "Internet: ", internet_c, ", ",
      "School: ", school_c, ", ",
      "logGDP: ", log_gdp_c
    )
  )

## Generate posterior predictions
set.seed(123)

posterior_preds <- posterior_draws %>%
  crossing(new_countries) %>%
  mutate(
    mu = b_Intercept +
         b_internet_c * internet_c +
         b_school_c   * school_c +
         b_log_gdp_c  * log_gdp_c,
    y_new = rnorm(n(), mean = mu, sd = b_sigma)
  )

## Summaries per scenario
posterior_summary <- posterior_preds %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_mu  = mean(mu),
    low_mu   = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    high_mu  = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    mean_y   = mean(y_new),
    low_y    = quantile(y_new, 0.025),
    high_y   = quantile(y_new, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

posterior_summary
```

```{r}
# Posterior predictive plots

## Plot 1: Expected life expectancy (mu)
ggplot(posterior_preds, aes(x = mu, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Distribution of Expected Life Expectancy (mu)",
    x = "Expected Life Expectancy",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Scenario\n(Internet, School, logGDP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Simulated observed life expectancy (y_new)
ggplot(posterior_preds, aes(x = y_new, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Predictive Distribution of Life Expectancy (y_new)",
    x = "Simulated Life Expectancy",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Scenario\n(Internet, School, logGDP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
## Posterior Predictive Checks

pp_check(wdi_model, type = "dens_overlay", nreps = 50) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Predictive Check: Observed vs Simulated Life Expectancy",
    x = "Life Expectancy",
    y = "Density")

posterior_preds_obs <- add_predicted_draws(cleaned, wdi_model, n = 50)
ggplot(posterior_preds_obs, aes(y = .prediction, x = lifeexp)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
labs(
title = "Observed vs Posterior Predicted Life Expectancy",
x = "Observed Life Expectancy",
y = "Predicted Life Expectancy"
) +
theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Posterior Predictive Summaries

set.seed(123)

## Generate posterior predictive draws for all observations
predictions <- posterior_predict(wdi_model, newdata = cleaned)

## Quick check of dimensions: rows = posterior draws, cols = countries
dim(predictions)

## Visualize posterior predictive intervals for all countries
ppc_intervals(y = cleaned$lifeexp, yrep = predictions, x = 1:nrow(cleaned),
              prob = 0.5, prob_outer = 0.95) +
  labs(
    x = "Country index",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    title = "Posterior Predictive Intervals for Observed Life Expectancy"
  )

# Numerical posterior predictive summaries
set.seed(123)
prediction_summary(wdi_model, data = cleaned)
```
